definitions.explanation: Giving a material such as plastic, metal, clay or dough a set shape, for example by pressing it into a mold. A manufacturing and craft term.

examples.japanese: ⟦{粘土|ねんど}→粘土：19435_nendo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{成形|せいけい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{丸|まる}く→丸い：02967_marui⟧{成形|せいけい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To shape bread dough into rounds.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{溶|と}かした→溶かす：08264_tokasu⟧⟦プラスチック→プラスチック：00347_purasuchikku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{金型|かながた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{流|なが}し{込|こ}んで→流し込む：29655_nagashikomu⟧{成形|せいけい}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This part is formed by pouring melted plastic into a mold.

notes:
{成|せい} (make, become) + ⟦{形|けい}→形：30925_kei⟧ (shape). Used in factories, pottery and baking. Plastic molding is often written {成型|せいけい}, with {型|けい} (mold).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {射出成形|しゃしゅつせいけい}: injection molding
- {成形|せいけい}⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧: molding, forming process
- {成形品|せいけいひん}: molded product
- ⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{成形|せいけい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to shape the dough

WATCH OUT:
⟦{整形|せいけい}→整形：09493_seikei⟧ (orthopedics; cosmetic surgery, as in ⟦{整形|せいけい}→整形：09493_seikei⟧⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧) sounds the same. {成形|せいけい} is about materials, ⟦{整形|せいけい}→整形：09493_seikei⟧ about the body.
